The '''2021–22 Tahiti Ligue 1''' was the 75th season of the [[Tahiti Ligue 1]], the top-flight [[Association football|football]] league in [[Tahiti]]. The season started on 5 November 2021.<ref>[https://tps.ftf.pf/2021-2022/ligue_1_vini], Fédération Tahitienne de Football</ref> [[A.S. Pirae]] are the defending champions.

==Teams==
{{location map+ |Tahiti |AlternativeMap=TahitiAndMoorea2021OSM.png |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2021–22 Tahiti Ligue 1 teams|places=
}}
A total of twelve teams compete in the league. [[A.S. Tamarii Punaruu|Tamarii Punaruu]] and [[A.S. Temanava]] were promoted from 2020 to 2021 [[Tahiti Ligue 2|Ligue 2]], replacing [[A.S. Manu-Ura|Manu-Ura]], [[A.S. Arue|Arue]] and [[A.S. Jeunes Tahitiens|Jeunes Tahitiens]] .
